Frequently asked questions about Acme portfolio

A new account type designed to centralize and streamline the management of multiple brand or regional accounts, and dramatically reduce the need for account switching.

It provides a global dashboard for tracking performance trends, either by individual account or collectively, and a unified hub for overseeing billing, product usage, and user access across all accounts.

There is no additional fee; portfolio creation is included with all paid accounts.

An account owner or admin can create a portfolio. All additional accounts must be added or removed by the portfolio owner. Only the portfolio owner can close a portfolio.

The portfolio owner must invite all teammates to be a user of the portfolio, where specific roles and permissions are applied.
